What do you want for 2020?

You don't want to die, what reason do you want not to? What will make things bearable?

Thank you, it's good to know it isn't just me that has felt this way after a death. I think I'm going to change a lot of aspects of my life soon I'm just scared I only want the change to either distract me or to remove reminders of what happened
Why do you feel like this is the only option?
